connector.name: Trade Router MCP by traderouter.ai
connector.registryDescription: Non-custodial Solana swap & limit order engine for AI agents.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package trade-router-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace ai.traderouter. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: TRADEROUTER_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Solana base58-encoded private key. Local signing only, never transmitted. See SECURITY.md.

env.name: TRADEROUTER_SERVER_PUBKEY
env.description: Optional override for the server public key used to verify order_filled ed25519 signatures.

env.name: TRADEROUTER_SERVER_PUBKEY_NEXT
env.description: Optional second server public key accepted during key rotation.

env.name: TRADEROUTER_REQUIRE_SERVER_SIGNATURE
env.description: Default 'true'. Verify server signatures on order_filled / twap_execution.

env.name: TRADEROUTER_REQUIRE_ORDER_CREATED_SIGNATURE
env.description: Default 'true'. Verify server signatures on order_created.

env.name: TRADEROUTER_DRY_RUN
env.description: Default 'false'. When 'true', write-action tools (submit_signed_swap, auto_swap, place_*_order, cancel_order, extend_order) short-circuit and return { dry_run: true, ... } instead of calling the API. Read-only tools execute normally.
